arguments.text: 8000 m, legs of 1250 m out-and-back (turns at 1250, 2500, 3750, 5000, 6250, 7500 m). Pacer sets effort from the POD reserve. My jobs: (1) keep the boat computer honest: watch pod power vs boat-model power, GPS speed and heart rate for pod drift; fix with set_belief pod_gain. (2) weed/drag: push_local drop within a leg -> clear_rudder (pacer also does this). (3) radio course changes -> set_race_distance + tell paddler. (4) listen to the paddler, treat as evidence. (5) near finish: make sure pod reserve reading is right so the finish push fires if it should. Baseline the ratios after the start settles (minutes 3-8).

arguments.text: 8000 m, legs 1250 m (turns at 1250, 2500, 3750, 5000, 6250, 7500 m). Pacer sets effort from the POD reserve (reads 0 since 700 s; its finish rule will not fire). CONCLUSION at 1094 s: true CP ~206-218 W pod, true reserve near empty, HR max ~173-174 (HR pinned = no reserve). Paddler self-paces ~228 W which is above CP -> blow-up risk. My effort lever: chained pieces at 0% (a new piece replaces the running one and is relative to the effort then held) to keep them at ~210-215 W. FINISH: in the last ~400 m (about 2 min) run a +10-15% piece to spend what is left. Keep watching for weed at turns (push_local vs same-direction leg; back-stroke fixed it at 839 s). Watch pod/boat ratio (~1.53) for pod drift. Radio course change -> set_race_distance + tell.
